limits.statement: The phase-8 build tip of the standalone manager is present in the local build clone and in the materialised submodule, but it is not published in the standalone origin, so a reconstruction from the remote alone is not possible.
The predecessor snapshot and its manifest are absent; the expected digest is only known by its prefix, so hash verification is unavailable and no verdict is published for it.

The integration branch of the consumer repository is based on a commit that is an ancestor of the current main; the references of this snapshot use the frozen base and a delivery over the moved main requires a rebase and a complete revalidation.

The legacy bash-core suite of the consumer repository keeps expecting the pre-backend exit codes of the crash hooks; the standalone manager now fails closed with the documented public exit codes. The gap is registered and is not repaired by this documentation increment.
One installer test fails with a type error; the failure is present before this increment and is registered as a known gap.

The standalone contracts describe the request envelope, the create options, the standard transport and the seven tools, but they do not name the plan digest that the consumer always sends; the implemented contract is the reference and the documentation gap is registered instead of rewriting the standalone contracts.
No publication was performed: the delivery to main and to the origin stays pending.
